idea-plugin.name: IDE-Radio
idea-plugin.description:
IDE Radio plays YouTube and Bilibili audio directly inside your IDE, featuring a live waveform and spectrum visualizer in a dedicated Tool Window.

Features

  • Audio Playback: Stream audio directly from YouTube and Bilibili URLs without video rendering overhead.
  • Dedicated Settings: Configure independent source slots for YouTube and Bilibili under Settings → Tools → IDE Radio. Preview track titles and duration before saving.
  • Mutually Exclusive Sources: Easily switch between active platforms with atomic source switching and unified session controls.
  • Transport Controls: Play, pause, stop, and loop playback (single-track loop enabled by default) from both the Settings page and the Tool Window.
  • Live Visualizer Tool Window: Real-time audio visualizer tool window at the bottom. Click the canvas to toggle between waveform and spectrum bar displays.
  • Cookie Support & Advanced Settings: Configure browser cookies or cookies.txt under Advanced Settings to mitigate Bilibili 412 rate-limiting.
  • Automatic Retries & Error Handling: Automatic retries (up to 3 times) with exponential backoff on network/412/429/5xx errors, featuring a manual [Retry] button.
  • Privacy Conscious: Stream URLs and authentication tokens are kept strictly in memory and sanitized in UI and logs.

Requirements

IDE Radio relies on local CLI tools to resolve and stream audio:

  • yt-dlp: Extracts audio stream info and metadata.
  • ffmpeg: Decodes remote audio streams to PCM for playback.

Note: yt-dlp and ffmpeg are not bundled with the plugin and must be installed on your system PATH or configured in Settings.
